mechanism: Torsemide causes electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which increases risk of QT prolongation and arrhythmias, and perphenazine has inherent QT-prolonging potential and anticholinergic/orthostatic effects potentiated by volume depletion.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, maintain potassium and magnesium levels, monitor ECG if prolonged use, and counsel on orthostatic precautions; consider alternative antipsychotic with lower QT risk if possible.
